# Sprint log

> One block per `/sprint-review`, **appended — never rewritten**. This is the project's memory: the record
> of what a sprint promised, what it actually shipped, and what it learned. Newest block at the bottom.
> Read the last 2–3 blocks before planning the next sprint — the retro lines are the only thing that stops
> the same mistake shipping twice.

## S<n> — <goal> · <date closed>
- **Goal:** <the demoable outcome the sprint promised>
- **Verdict:** hit · partial · missed
- **Shipped:** `#id title` (PR #nn) · `#id title` (PR #nn) …
  <!-- only issues that MERGED with a passing receipt. Verified is the bar, not "code written". -->
- **Demoable:** <one or two sentences a stakeholder would understand>
- **Carry-overs:** `#id title — why it didn't land` · … (or "none")
- **Retro (≤3):** <concrete, actionable adjustment> · <…> · <…>
